items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves an injectivity statement for the sections of a derived limit: under a vanishing hypothesis on R^1 lim of the cohomology of the system over a cofinal system of coverings, and a stability hypothesis in degree m, the map H^m(R lim K_n)(V) -> H^m(K_{n(V)})(V) is injective (statement lines 5278-5291). The proof writes the standard exact sequence relating the derived limit to the limit and R^1 lim (proof lines 5293-5305), and then uses the two hypotheses to kill the extra term and identify the limit with the term at the chosen level (proof lines 5305-5317). The non-formal content is the reading of the hypotheses in the exact sequence. The claim is H2: one exact sequence plus one application of the hypotheses.
